questions.stem:
Find the emf of the cell of given reaction :
\(\mathrm{Zn(s) + 2Ag^{+}(aq) \longrightarrow Zn^{+2}(aq) + 2Ag(s)}\)
Given \(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Zn^{+2}/Zn}} = -0.76\ \mathrm{V}\) and \(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Ag^{+}/Ag}} = +0.80\ \mathrm{V}\)

hi.stem:
निम्न अभिक्रिया वाले सेल का वि.वा.बल ज्ञात कीजिए :
\(\mathrm{Zn(s) + 2Ag^{+}(aq) \longrightarrow Zn^{+2}(aq) + 2Ag(s)}\)
दिया है \(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Zn^{+2}/Zn}} = -0.76\ \mathrm{V}\) तथा \(E^\circ_{\mathrm{Ag^{+}/Ag}} = +0.80\ \mathrm{V}\)

questions._flag: Stamps cross '(aq)' after Zn+2 in both prints and the Hindi 'बल' (वि.वा.बल = emf); each settled by the other print.
